name: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B
title: Small footprint
reason: A compact starting point for explanations and short tasks. Leave complex repository changes to a larger model.

name: Qwen/Qwen3-4B
title: Everyday assistant
reason: A small general assistant with optional reasoning, for machines with limited memory.

name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct
title: Focused coding
reason: A code-focused instruction model for edits, explanations, and completion.

name: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
title: More room to reason
reason: A general assistant with more capacity for multi-step tasks, at a higher memory cost.

name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B
title: Reasoning specialist
reason: For working through difficult questions. Reasoning takes extra tokens; this is not the default choice for tool-driven builds.

name: Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
title: Larger coding workflows
reason: A mixture-of-experts coding model for higher-memory machines. All weights must fit, even though only some experts activate per token.
